# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 release** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 brings the m151 renderer to stable together with managed perf work and newer WASM assets. The release combines repeated upstream m151 syncs with targeted performance improvements in color, shaping and data paths, plus new .NET 11 WebAssembly native assets and servicing fixes discovered during the preview cycle.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **The stable line advanced to Skia milestone m151** — SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the bundled renderer to m151 and folds in several rounds of upstream Chrome bug fixes that shipped across the preview and release-candidate cycle. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **CPU raster behavior was corrected for the new engine line** — The release restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to address a CPU raster regression uncovered during m151 validation. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **SKColor parsing gained span-friendly entry points** — Hex color parsing is faster and now includes ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, making it easier to consume color values from buffers without allocating intermediate strings. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **GRContextOptions shed an unnecessary unsafe marker** — The managed API no longer requires unsafe context for GRContextOptions, simplifying consumption in codebases that avoid unsafe compilation where possible. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **Encoded-image subset loading no longer leaks native resources** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) now releases native allocations correctly on the subset path, preventing resource growth in repeated decode scenarios. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **Preview .NET WASM validation now guards the release line** — The release line adds the native and test support needed to catch WebAssembly exception-handling regressions early, including the new Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Core color and text hot paths were moved onto cheaper managed code paths** — Several frequently used conversions and parsers now avoid per-call allocations or native round-trips, including SKColor to SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply helpers, SKShaper glyph extraction, SKFourByteTag parsing, and HarfBuzzSharp UTF-8/tag parsing. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with faster AddUtf8 and tag parsing paths, alongside the broader text-shaping allocation work in the 4.151 release line.
